# Stepan Kukharskiy
Architect, computational designer, and technical founder.

I'm the co-founder of SA lab and currently building Spellshape — an AI-native system for generating editable parametric 3D, which I see as a first step toward a design world model.

I've been working with parametric design since 2010, across architecture, computation, and interactive 3D. My work focuses on turning design intent into structured systems, spatial logic, and tools that remain editable, extensible, and buildable.

## What I Do
I work across computational architecture, procedural design, AI, and product development. Through SA lab, my architectural work has been published on platforms including ArchDaily and Designboom, and I also develop projects for virtual environments such as Decentraland and Worlds.

## Projects
- Spellshape: AI-native system for generating editable parametric 3D
- SA lab: Algorithmic architecture and computational design practice

## Skills
Rhino, Grasshopper, Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine, Arduino, SvelteKit, Svelte, Firebase, Supabase, PocketBase, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Three.js, parametric design, procedural generation, computational geometry, real-time 3D, AI workflows, and interactive prototyping.

## Speaking
Alongside product and design work, I give lectures, webinars, and workshops on computational design, AI workflows, and emerging spatial tools for international design communities including DesignMorphine and DigitalFUTURES.
